task.title: Completing Designer Setup in Salesforce
task.shortdesc: To permit Designers to assign apps they have created to users and use the Launch

context.p: To permit Designers to assign apps they have created to users and use the Launch from Salesforce feature, a Salesforce admin must add two buttons to the App Page Layout: the Assign button and the Excel Setup button.
For Microsoft Dynamics instructions, refer to Launching an X-Author for Excel App from Microsoft Dynamics.
